profile.headline: Software Engineer at DirecTV
profile.summary: Qualified Java developer with over 8 years of experience in developing dynamic enterprise-level web applications. Proven ability to coordinate the full software development lifecycle, including requirements gathering, application design, programming, code verification, testing, debugging, and deployment. Adept at solving complex technology challenges through innovation and technical expertise. Strong background working on international client projects.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed a new platform to manage the broadcast systems configuration.
• Developed RESTful APIs with Spring Boot 
• Built an On-Premise system to monitor RESTful APIs based on ELK stack.
• Identified and addressed compliance gaps to meet the Security Policy & Requirements compliance.
• Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Mockito, Kafka, React-Redux, AWS (API Gateway, Lambda, EC2, S3, RDS, DynamoDB, Cognito), ELK stack, MySQL, MongoDB, JavaScript, Jenkins, Git.
• Achievement: Succeeded on building a new platform that help manage bandwidth, broadcast channel, and broadcast systems configuration.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed an e-commerce platform for trading chemicals between Boeing and its partners.
• Developed a streaming system to sync customer and contact data between existing SAP CRM and new Salesforce system.
• Technologies: Java 8, Spring Boot, Hibernate, Mockito, RabbitMQ, React-Redux, MySQL, JavaScript, Git.
• Achievement: Succeeded on building a streaming system to integrate Boeing’s internal system with partners’ external systems.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Led software project development through life cycle process, including definition of project scope, drafting of plan and schedule, estimation of timeline and cost, and tracking of project progress.
•	Designed, developed and tested multithreaded applications and RESTful web services.
•	Improved code coverage and performance through troubleshooting and refactoring.
•	Wrote unit and integration tests for software applications and components.
•	Supervised and trained staff to ensure quality and performance; maintained internal morale.
•	Handled application deployment. Provided technical support and troubleshooting.
•	Technologies: Java, Spring, Hibernate, Angular, PostgreSQL, JavaScript, HTML5, CSS3, AJAX, RabbitMQ, AWS, Git.

positions.title: Senior Java Developer
positions.description:
Designed and developed complete solutions based on client requirements, using advanced technologies and SDLC techniques such as sprint planning and design documentation.
•	Authored software architecture and design documents.
•	Coordinated with clients and other diverse teams to ensure requirements are met or exceeded.
•	Implemented automated test suites. Trained end users in software use and bug reporting.
•	Technologies: Java, Spring, Hibernate, AngularJS, MySQL, Jenkins, JavaScript, Jira, SVN, Eclipse, HTML, CSS, Bootstrap.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed software applications included Finance Process Manager web application, Cash Management Android application, and e-Commerce web application.
•	Investigated existing software to resolve bugs and developed new software solutions.
•	Improved code coverage and performance through troubleshooting and refactoring.
•	Technologies: Java, EJB, Servlet, JSP, Oracle, JBoss, JavaScript, SVN, Eclipse, HTML, CSS.
